title: Outcome of erasure or match work
description: What an edge store hands in through P1 complete for work of kind erasure: the outcome done, failed or not_applicable and, for match, a list of ids of what was found, without content (RET-4, RET-7, SEC-11). not_applicable without a basis is not accepted: otherwise a store could close a request on its word alone.

ids.description: Only match: ids of the store objects where the strings occurred; no content.

reason.description: For failed, a reason from the registry.

basis.description: Only for not_applicable: by which sign the store made sure that there is nothing to delete. declared_none: the store declared in hello that it holds no content; tenant_absent: the store has no data of this tenant; no_match: none of the needles strings was found in its records; kind_not_held: the store does not hold the data kind of the scope by its sheet (for example, a monitoring note carries no data about people).
